body:
Parent: #2180
Depends on: #1715, #2177, #2178, #2179

## 原子目标

实现 canonical comment exact-plan rerun repair，并删除 legacy actor、精确隐私属性写入、direct comment/moderation/appeal SQL、手写 parent/root/depth、first-pending/row-count discovery、compat actor/writer/helper/fallback。Rerun 只消费 #2177–#2179 verified plan/receipts，精确恢复 operation-owned comment graph、timeline、outbox、queue/cache/notification与 privacy proofs，且重复执行不累计事实。

## 当前基线与固定删除清单

- legacy positive actor 与 `legacy_server_visible_pseudonymous` 等 current-equivalent aliases。
- `credential_level`、`reputation_bucket`、`account_age_bucket` 等 fake positive private attrs。
- Node/shell/C#/test direct comment/revision/moderation/appeal SQL或 private writes。
- 手写 parent/root/depth/thread关系与 direct depth bypass。
- first pending/approved/any comment、row-count/queue-count/status-only discovery/verifier。
- direct DB + 补 revision/outbox、single comment all states。
- compat actor/writer/helper/feature flag/warning fallback。

## 必须交付

1. Canonical rerun command只接受 verified plan、semantic roles、current command/timeline/edge receipts与 expected generation/revision；不得发现环境实体。
2. 精确恢复 operation-owned actor/privacy/thread/root/depth/current version/history、moderation timeline/status/reason/appeal、nullifier/capability、outbox、public/admin/queue/cache/notification state。
3. 故意污染 author mode、private attrs、thread/depth、version/history、timeline/status/reason、outbox/nullifier/capability、queue/cache/notification后，rerun恢复 plan exact facts/counts。
4. 删除 non-plan owned revisions/events/outbox/evidence/queue entries/notifications并按 production contracts重建；不得修改 article/auth/security 或 non-owned comments。
5. 同 plan重复执行不累计 revision/event/outbox/audit/notification/nullifier consume，不改 immutable history或无因推进 generation。
6. Missing/partial failure输出 recovery-required，不用 direct SQL/compat writer/warning成功。
7. Public/admin/queue/cache/notification与 privacy proof outputs绑定 source/worktree/run/profile/comment/plan/generation/content digests。
8. 不修改 product comment/moderation/privacy/nullifier semantics。

## 固定约束

- 唯一 authorities：#2177 canonical command、#2178 mutation timeline、#2179 derived edge verifier。
- 允许修改 rerun repair/legacy paths/focused tests。
- 禁止 second writer、manual thread/projection、first-row/count-only、fake private attrs、allowlist。
- 不修改 #1794。

## 必须测试

1. clean canonical rerun正向与第二次幂等。
2. actor/private attrs/thread/root/depth drift精确恢复。
3. version/history/timeline/status/reason/appeal恢复。
4. outbox/nullifier/capability/queue/cache/notification恢复。
5. non-plan owned outputs删除，article/auth/security/non-owned comments不受影响。
6. legacy actor/fake private attrs/direct SQL/manual thread mutation失败。
7. first-pending/row-count/status-only/single-comment-all-states失败。
8. direct DB+fake revision/outbox、disable nullifier/policy失败。
9. compat actor/writer/helper/feature flag/warning fallback失败。
10. cross-profile/comment/plan/generation/tamper与 parallel cleanup失败。

## 验收条件

- [ ] Canonical rerun只消费 verified plan/receipts，不发现环境 comment。
- [ ] `node --test tests/tools/comment-fixture-rerun.test.mjs` 通过。
- [ ] 同 plan重复执行不累计 revision/event/outbox/audit/notification/nullifier facts。
- [ ] legacy actor/private attrs/direct SQL/manual thread/first-row/count-only active paths为0。
- [ ] compat actor/writer/helper/fallback/feature flag/warning路径为0。
- [ ] 本 PR 未实现 #2693治理或修改产品 comment/privacy语义。

## 非目标

- #2693 scanner/mutation/privacy/terminal acceptance。
- 不实现 #2177–#2179基础或测试 comment UI。
- 不增加内容/scale/language variants。
title: test(test-fixtures): 修复 canonical comment rerun legacy 清理
